integrity.scope: all integers 3 <= t <= min(a,b); finite simple labelled graphs

scientific_limitations: The maximal-subset formula assumes 3 <= t <= min(a,b). It concerns vertex-induced cographs, not edge-deletion cographs. Finite checks substantiate but do not prove the all-parameter theorem. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: Cograph cardinality polynomials of matching-joined cliques
